range_summary.text: AI estimate, not solver/GTO. Choose a conservative whole-range check at this first flop action. BB has substantial connected-board coverage; both ranges contain T7/75 straights, while BTN retains AA–QQ. Checking keeps nuts and strong draws alongside vulnerable showdown hands and air; no lead size is used. This deliberately forgoes potentially profitable leads, not a claim that every hand prefers checking. Physical blockers differ but do not change this chosen policy. Treat supplied weights as marginal reach, not a joint deal distribution; do not multiply matching opponent reach into BB reach. No downstream policies or numerical EV/equity are assumed.
